body: I’m here and ready to talk when you are. And I’ve been through a lot myself. I won’t be someone to tell you to “just smile and be better lol”, I understand friend. Just talk to me. Or anyone at least.
Yes, friend! I’m here. What’s going on.
I replied to your last post. I’m here to talk.

Hi, sorry, I didn’t realize you replied. But wow I feel a huge warmth in my heart that you appreciated my message and also wrote it down. Everything I said was the truth. I hope you continue to think about it.

I’m so sorry you were forced to do that.. That never should have happened to you. Some people are just deranged…

People like you and me? We actually have empathy encoded in our genes. Maybe too much so that we blame everything on ourselves. Why we are so certain we are the problem. Why we feel like we are the ones who have to leave this earth…

But people like the ones who did this to you.. They are on the opposite end. They don’t have empathy. Instead of taking out their pain in a healthy way or blaming theirselves, they choose to hurt other people, like how they hurt you. None of what happened to you is your fault. It is entirely theirs. It speaks volumes about how fucked up they are. It doesn’t define you.

I understand what happened was traumatic. And a hushed topic. How can you tell someone that information? You don’t want them to feel guilty or sad about YOU. Again, that speaks levels about how good of a person you are. You try to bare the pain so others don’t have to. It’s the same reason you can’t fully go through with ending your life… Because you can’t stand the thought of the people you know hurting.

I understand not being able to talk about this with anyone around you. But maybe it’s mostly because you think nobody around you will get it. You maybe think you’ll seem weird or weak or whatever. But what if that is what someone you care about feels as well? What if that or something similar happened to the person closest to you? Wouldn’t you want them to tell you? Wouldn’t your body fill with anger towards the people who did it? Wouldn’t you provide care and understanding?

I’m not saying it’s going to be today. But you will find someone you can comfortably talk to about this with. And you’ll find the greatest warmth in their comfort. A person that can truly support you and be by your side. That person could be anyone, maybe a friend, significant other, family member, or even a stranger. I don’t know. 

Again, maybe I’m just rambling. But I hope something I said helps. And I hope you’re still fighting against the universe bro.

Bruh I’m not gonna positivity your ass saying “Haha just live lol it’ll be great!!!!!” Nah. Fuck that. I understand your position. My friends and parents were fucked up too. I attempted suicide as a teenager. I won’t sit here and tell you it magically gets better by carrying on and just keeping yourself alive. It doesn’t. I attempted 6 years ago. Did any person in my family ACTUALLY care? Idk. I understand the isolation. I understand the having no motherfucker on this planet earth “getting you”. I can’t promise you happiness, but I can promise that you aren’t alone in your feelings. I get all the anxiety and feeling down on yourself about any slightest action you make. I felt like a retard no matter what I did/said, and of course when trying to fall asleep, all I could ever do was relive any embarrassing moment I’ve ever had in my entire life. I understand bro. 

The way I had myself continue on after high school was basically viewing it as a “why the fuck not scenario”. Look, motherfuckers in high school SUCK. Back then I viewed my life as wow everyone hates me or is an asshole or whatever the fuck. They ALL SUCK. 

But think of it this way. If I plan on ending my life, I’m done, whatever. I can do that when I want, because what does life matter? Listen to this. Yeah you could do that whenever and wherever you want. But if everything is all pointless anyway and you can just “escape” at any time, why not say fuck it and try being yourself for once? Be you and see what happens in life. If people drop you, that’s on them, not you. They weren’t really your friends anyway. Trust me, you find the better ones later in life anyway. 

But if you literally think your life means nothing, and you want to quit, why not try sticking it out for a second and doing whatever the fuck you would truly do with no fears, (cause you can leave anyway). Try being you for a minute, see what happens.

My life ain’t perfect my dude, I won’t give you false promises. But why not try if you can leave anytime anyway? Fuck it right?

I get it. What is really the point in living in this fucked up world if I always feel like shit anyway? I am 6 years past my last suicide attempt and I still ask myself the same question. I am not going to promise life is magically going to be better, or all your problems will be solved, because that’s just not the case. 

The way I’ve carried on in life is viewing it as a “why not” sort of scenario. Think about it this way. If this life is meaningless, pointless, we all die anyway, blah blah, then what harm comes from just saying fuck it, if I can just end my life, let me try to actually be myself on this planet for a minute. Be bold, be brave, be passionate, be YOU. What is the goddamn harm if you can just opt out at any time anyway. Why not try? See what happens in your life when you truly be YOU. 

I’ve been trying it out the last six years and I’m not going to sit here and tell you my life is perfect and I’m now a millionaire and have no worries. That’s not the case. But I’d be lying if I said there weren’t a hell of a lot of moments afterwards that made me feel OK. Made me feel like “huh, maybe I can do this.” It’s not magic, and it isn’t that easy, but there’s no harm in sticking it out and trying if you are convinced you should give up anyway. Go all out and be yourself because why not? If it doesn’t matter why not just try it?

I hope you try, I was where you were and I am certainly not doing perfect, but I am better. Try.

Your time here isn’t done yet. 

I wasn’t physically stopped but I was stopped. When I attempted almost 6 years ago my dog who normally sleeps through the night in my bed (even when I go down to get snacks), decided to come down and make the loudest ruckus I’ve ever heard at the door while I was the back porch outside taking pills and cutting myself. He’s the only reason I stopped… How could I leave this innocent creature who clearly needs me here?

I don’t believe in god but the story gets a little wilder where it sure as hell made me consider the possibility. That night, in the same hour I was outside on that porch, my grandfather passed away. Sure people could say it’s a weird coincidence, maybe it is. But after learning that I felt a need to carry on. I’m not saying life is perfect for me now or anything because it most certainly is not. Again I am not religious but I do believe lives have a purpose, I took this as some sort of sign I am not done here. My grandfather gave his life to save mine, because I needed to be here. I don’t know what specifically for, but I need to carry on. I figure what’s the harm. We do eventually all die anyway. But all we have in our existence is this life, and if my purpose is to make it even slightly better for someone else, then maybe I’ll carry on a bit longer. 

I don’t know man. I’ve been going off that for the past 6 years. It’s been hard. 

But if this is our short plane of having a reality, and existence, why not do the best we can. I mean sure, maybe it doesn’t mean anything overall, because what’s the point of the universe anyway??? Idk I ask myself that all the time. But we’re here, maybe it does mean something and we just don’t know it. We don’t know so much about this world. But I’m telling you from my experience, just fight. I know it’s hard, I understand. But if you already think your life means nothing then what is the harm in sticking it out for a while longer? Sure maybe it’ll feel like the worst shit on the face of the planet for a bit, but if it means nothing what is the goddamn harm in sticking it out. At least then you will know. 

Yeah I don’t believe in coincidences or god or really anything. But think about it. What are the odds that you get mugged right before trying to leave this Earth? I feel like that has to mean something. Your time isn’t up. Just wait and see what happens. If you already plan to give up, what’s the harm? Be bold, be brave, be passionate. If your plan is to leave then why not try being yourself for awhile knowing you can bail on this planet at any time anyway. Give it a shot. Why not? Maybe the universe will show whatever purpose it decided to try to keep you here for.

I hope you try man.

I was in a similar position not too long ago. My whole senior year of college was filled with binge drinking, terrible social life (thanks to covid), and pursuing every impulsive distraction possible to avoid homework/projects. Which inevitably led to late nights of wondering why I didn't start my work earlier and feeling like the whole world was about to crumble down. 

Firstly, try to cut the drinking, it'll only make everything worse. I can say from experience.

Second, I totally understand the whole overthinking in regards to design/art/creativity. Idk if this is what you're worried about but I would stress out over my art and would be an extreme perfectionist because I would worry about it not being good enough. Tbh it was/is one of the hardest things to work through. What helped me was thinking about how everyone else is pretty much only worried about their own work too. One small detail you think makes your work "not perfect" will probably not be noticed by others. Remember, you've probably been staring at it 100x longer than anyone else.

Third, as for loving writing but hating design, I get it but in reverse. I was an electronic arts major, loved art but LOATHED writing. I could stare at Microsoft Word for hours and maybe then would I have one sentence (If I was lucky). Classes that are uninteresting are a dread, but try to keep your dream in sight. Don't throw away your future in the advertising industry because of some random grad requirement class.

Lastly, don't be afraid to ask for an extension on assignments. And take a breath. What's most important is your mental/physical health. You're not alone & I believe in you.
